question: List the names of customers, alphabetically, who have never ordered any product in the 'kitchen' category (via a completed order).

gold.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (  SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o   JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id   JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id   WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'kitchen') ORDER BY name ASC
